elements.title: Salient Statistics—United States
elements.content:
|                         | 2019 | 2020 | 2021 | 2022e | 2023e |
|-------------------------|-------|-------|-------|-------|-------|
| Production              | 366   | 354   | 324   | e350  | 360   |
| Sales by producers      | 420   | 388   | 386   | e510  | 510   |
| Imports for consumption | 1,160 | 1,390 | 1,630 | 1,440 | 1,100 |
| Exports                 | 46    | 46    | 37    | 43    | 46    |
| Consumption, apparent1  | 1,400 | 1,690 | 1,970 | 1,750 | 1,400 |
| Price, average unit value, f.o.b. mine, dollars per metric ton | 25.77 | 26.07 | 38.52 | 27.49 | 31.70 |
| Stocks, producer, yearend | 280 | 288 | 235 | 235 | 240 |
| Employment, mine and plant, numbere | 520 | 510 | 510 | 510 | 500 |
| Net import reliance2 as a percentage of apparent consumption | 74 | 79 | 84 | 80 | 74 |
elements.notes:
1 Apparent consumption = Production + Imports - Exports.
2 Net import reliance = (Imports - Exports) / Apparent consumption × 100.
Source: U.S. Geological Survey.
